allocator_architecture.actual_Runtime: Runtime constructs one infini::rt::ReusableMemoryPool per owner Runtime and borrows its ordinary stream. Runtime::allocateMemory and allocateParameterMemory use the same pool; Memory deleters capture shared Runtime and releaseDeviceMemory.
allocator_architecture.refs: Normal Memory final release calls deallocate; reinstantiateBlob increments physical allocation use_count once per resumed Memory. Foreign-thread release first synchronizes original Runtime stream and retains allocation if completion cannot be proven. Graph PinLease retains shared pool state; pinned bytes are unique physical blocks with pin_count>0.
allocator_architecture.retained_pool_source_contract: State has mutex-protected all_blocks, size-class free lists, large/exact list. Block has size, in_use, use_count, pin_count. allocate aligns to256 and uses classes32KiB..256MiB or large/exact. deallocate decrements use_count, then marks free; trim frees only free unpinned blocks. Hygon allocation_stream is null and uses runtime Malloc/Free, while NVIDIA uses async stream allocation.
allocator_architecture.lifetime: Pool state destructor drains original stream before backing storage release and stream destruction; committed graph pin leases may outlive user-facing pool object. Do not clear live outputs/parameters/cache or reinterpret private State to force release.
allocator_architecture.not_measured: Class sizes/formulas are source contracts only. No current-run allocator bin distribution, allocated bytes, reserved bytes, free-cache bytes or exact driver reclaim was captured.
